LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Up_2: Word of {COLONY} has spread: its name is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Up_3: More people speak of {COLONY} than before: its name is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Up_4: What the colony's people have done has carried its name further: {COLONY} is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Up_5: Travelers and traders carry the name of {COLONY} with them: it is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_UpFor: The name of {COLONY} is {RENOWN} now, and it is known for {KNOWNFOR}.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_UpFor_2: {COLONY} is {RENOWN} now, and those who speak of it know it for {KNOWNFOR}.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_UpFor_3: Word of {COLONY} has spread, and with it what the colony is known for: {KNOWNFOR}. Its name is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_UpFor_4: The name of {COLONY} carries further now: it is {RENOWN}, known for {KNOWNFOR}.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_UpFor_5: What the colony's people have done is talked of beyond its walls: {COLONY} is {RENOWN} now, for {KNOWNFOR}.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Down: Fewer speak of {COLONY} than before: its name is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Down_2: The talk of {COLONY} has narrowed: its name is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Down_3: Other news has taken the place of {COLONY} in people's talk: its name is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Down_4: The name of {COLONY} carries less far than it did: it is {RENOWN} now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Down_5: What the colony was known for is older news now, and its name is {RENOWN}.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Faded: The name of {COLONY} has faded from the talk outside the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Faded_2: Nobody outside speaks of {COLONY} much any more.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Faded_3: The talk of {COLONY} outside its walls has died down.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Faded_4: Whatever was said of {COLONY} out there has been forgotten for now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Faded_5: {COLONY} has gone quiet in the talk of the region.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Infamous: {COLONY} has a bad name now: outside the colony its people are spoken of for the wrong things.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Infamous_2: The name of {COLONY} has gone bad: what is said of it outside is said of its wrongs.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Infamous_3: People outside speak of {COLONY} now, and not kindly.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Infamous_4: {COLONY} is known outside for the wrong things now, and its people will meet that name on the road.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Infamous_5: What the colony has done wrong has carried further than what it did well: {COLONY} has a bad name now.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Mended: The bad name of {COLONY} is fading from the talk outside the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Mended_2: People outside have stopped holding the old wrongs against {COLONY}, mostly.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Mended_3: The talk of the wrongs of {COLONY} has died down.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Mended_4: The bad name of {COLONY} is older news now, and fewer repeat it.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Mended_5: Outside the colony, the wrongs {COLONY} was known for are spoken of less and less.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_Does: Notables think up to {REGARD} better of the colony's people for it, a good word for them counts for more, and matches with them are taken up more readily.
LanguageData.CC_Renown_Colony_DoesBad: Notables think up to {REGARD} worse of the colony's people for it.

LanguageData.CC_RenownPage_Sub: How far the colony's name carries among the peoples and what it is known for, and its people known by name for what they did.
LanguageData.CC_RenownPage_NoneNamed: Nobody of the colony is known by name outside it yet. A contest won, a ward fostered well, a camp broken or a people's wounded tended, and the name comes.
LanguageData.CC_RenownPage_Unnamed: Not yet known by name outside the colony: {NAMES}.
LanguageData.CC_Dip_Married_None: No marriage binds the colony to another people yet.
LanguageData.CC_Ward_OfferTown: Word has come from {WHO} of {PEOPLE}. A youth of {TOWN} would come to live at the colony for a year and learn {SKILL}, which the colony is known for. They call it {RITE}; here it would be {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Ward_OfferTown_2: {WHO} of {PEOPLE} writes that a youth of {TOWN} should learn {SKILL} away from home, and asks whether the colony will keep them a year: {RITE}, as their people put it.
LanguageData.CC_Ward_OfferTown_3: {PEOPLE} write by {WHO}'s hand: a youth of {TOWN} is of an age to learn {SKILL}, and they would trust the colony with them for a year. They call it {RITE}; the colony would call it {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Ward_OfferTown_4: A youth of {TOWN} is to be sent away for a year to learn {SKILL}, {WHO} writes, and {PEOPLE} have chosen the colony for it: {RITE}, as they put it.
LanguageData.CC_Ward_OfferTown_5: {WHO} of {PEOPLE} asks a favor that is also a compliment. Would the colony keep a youth of {TOWN} for a year and teach them {SKILL}? Here it would be {WORD}.
